description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest supported Java framework/runtime baseline for modernization readiness.
tasks.reason: The current Java 8 and javax-based stack is legacy and should be upgraded before cloud-native migration tasks.
tasks.requirements: Modernize the application to the latest framework/runtime baseline for Java, including required project and dependency updates needed to support subsequent Azure migration tasks.

tasks.description: Modernize application dependencies to Azure cloud-native managed services.
tasks.reason: Per-plan execution goals require moving to cloud-native services as part of modernization.
tasks.requirements: Modernize core platform dependencies to Azure cloud-native services, including managed database, configuration, and secrets management integrations aligned to application behavior.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security compliance requires dependency vulnerability remediation in every modernization plan.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions and validate build/test health after remediation; document any major-version risk if required.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.reason: The modernization goal explicitly requires deployment to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize as needed and deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps with production-ready configuration and validation.
tasks.resourceStatus: Create new Azure Container Apps environment and supporting resources
